## Terms

### Operation rejection filters

- **Operation rejection filters** · self — Operation rejection filters are not available on Atlas Free (M0) or Flex clusters. The manual lists `setQuerySettings`, `removeQuerySettings` and `$querySettings` as unsupported there. For unsupported commands on those tiers, Atlas returns '<command> is not allowed or the syntax is incorrect, see th — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/current/tutorial/operation-rejection-filters/
